Subject: Kickstart: BrightNorth evaluation alignment & final sprint schedule

Emma — great to meet earlier. Quick post-call recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth going into the kickoff. Thanks for taking time.

Summary (from today's discovery)
- Goal: Validate Redwood Inference for BrightNorth's automated policy extraction pipeline (throughput and cost targets + accuracy on 3 canonical prompts).
- Success criteria (proposed):
  * Accuracy: >= 92% F1 on the three labeled prompt sets (legal-extract, policy-map, exception-detect)
  * Latency: p95 response under 350ms for 256-token generation on Dedicated-like load (concurrent 8 sessions)
  * Cost: projected token cost <= $0.012/token under expected batch profile
- Timeline: 3-week evaluation; kickoff on Mon Jun 21, weekly 45-min check-ins (Wed 10:00 PT), final readout Fri Jul 9.
- Ownership: Redwood CS lead: Marissa Cole; Solutions Eng: Priyom Das; Customer PM: Emma Lee.
- Tech/access asks: S3 sample dataset (anonymized), service account for test API keys, list of top-10 prompts + acceptance label set.

Open items / asks for BrightNorth
1) Confirm kickoff date (we proposed Mon Jun 21) and weekly cadence.
2) Share sample dataset (s3 link or sample csv) before Jun 18 so SE can pre-seed evaluation harness.
3) Confirm who will attend weekly check-ins from your side (suggest: Platform eng + PM).
4) Any procurement/SOW signoff needed before we run the Dedicated-like tests (DocuSign link below if ready).

Attachments: BN-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan; simple milestones + owners)

If the dates look good I'll send calendar invites + short runbook for the kickoff and assign tasks in the MAP.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
